verdict: Leads are up, cost per lead is down — but Google spend is wasted.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $15.80 per lead, entirely through Meta — and the week-over-week trend is moving in the right direction, with leads up 5.56% and cost per lead down 2.67%. Google Ads, however, spent $508.73 over the same period and produced zero conversions across 115 clicks — that budget is being pulled from Google and the channel is under immediate review. Separately, 137 leads entered your pipeline this period but none advanced to a booked appointment, which points to a gap in how leads are being followed up after they come in, not an issue with the ads themselves. We're working through the pipeline process now to identify and close that drop-off. Expect offline conversion tracking to be live by end of September, which will sharpen how both Meta and Google optimize going forward.
